explanation: This slide concludes the visual representation of Mendel's monohybrid cross, highlighting how the mathematical analysis of offspring phenotypes allowed Mendel to infer underlying genotypic behavior.

questions.q: What mathematical tool is commonly used to predict the genotypes and phenotypes of offspring in a monohybrid cross?
questions.exp: Option B is correct because a Punnett square is the standard graphical table used to predict genotypes and phenotypes resulting from a cross.
